study: close-to-next-open overnight hold, Robinhood 24h market, ~$700 whole-share account
trade: buy at close[t] in the evening session, sell at open[t+1]; gross = 1e4*(open[t+1]/close[t]-1)

gates.note: price/ADV gate applied at TRADE TIME so a $700 whole-share account could actually have taken the trade

cost_models.cs: Corwin-Schultz 2012 high-low spread, per symbol-year, neg 2-day est floored at 0; NOISE-INFLATED UPPER BOUND
cost_models.ar: Abdi-Ranaldo 2017 close-high-low, per symbol-year; unbiased aggregation but very noisy
cost_models.tick1: 100/close bp = cross a 1-cent spread; PHYSICAL FLOOR

variants.name: 1a_uncond_smallcap_gated
variants.note: sub-$50 universe, price $2-50 and 20d ADV>=$20M at trade time

variants.name: 1b_uncond_smallcap_ungated
variants.note: same 522 names, no historical price/ADV gate

variants.name: 4c_monthend_last1_smallcap
variants.note: buy on last trading day of month

variants.name: 4d_monthend_last1_largecap
variants.note: buy on last trading day of month

variants.name: 5a_smallcap_prevdown3pct_monthend2
variants.note: prior-day <-3% AND last 2 trading days of month

variants.name: 2a_signal_overnight_only_smallcap
variants.note: RSI2<5 & close>SMA200: overnight leg only, close[t]->open[t+1]

variants.name: 2b_signal_overnight_only_largecap
variants.note: RSI2<5 & close>SMA200: overnight leg only, close[t]->open[t+1]

cost_walls.note: wall = max flat round-trip cost in bp at which PF(gross-cost) >= 1.3 on OOS trades

rh_offhours_book_cost_250usd_clip.what: level-2 book walk, cost of buying then selling a $250 clip, ROUND TRIP bp
rh_offhours_book_cost_250usd_clip.caveat: premarket snapshots (~09:17/09:23 ET), not the 16:00-20:00 evening session; a handful of names show broken/stale quotes (SIRI 745-885bp)

rh_session_liquidity.finding: the true overnight window (20:00-04:00 ET) printed ZERO volume for all 36 sampled names over two weeks; the 16:00-20:00 evening session carries a median 0.73% of the day's volume

verdict.one_line: The close-to-next-open gap is real and stable but is only +5 to +15bp gross; no variant holds PF>=1.3 OOS above a ~6bp round-trip cost, and a real Robinhood off-hours round trip on a $250 clip costs ~45bp (median), with a hard 1-tick floor of ~4.7bp on the sub-$50 universe.

cost_wall_that_kills_it_bp.required_flat_cost_stress_results: at flat 10bp round trip every broad variant is negative or PF<1.05 OOS; at 20/30/40bp all are negative

verdict.entry_switch_answer: NO — moving the deployed RSI(2) dip entry from the next open into the evening session is worth +4.1bp (small caps, t=1.97) / +12.0bp (large caps, t=6.55) OOS gross. The small-cap number is below the 1-tick floor (4.7bp) let alone the ~22bp extra off-hours half-spread, so the switch is value-destroying on exactly the names a $700 whole-share account trades.
